name: AgriOS Valve Command Feedback Forwarding
description: Skeleton rule chain for forwarding electric-valve telemetry and command ACK messages to AgriOS /api/v1/device-control/valves/feedback.

configuration.jsScript: var body = JSON.parse(msg); return {msg: {commandId: body.lastCommandId || body.commandId, deviceId: metadata.agriosDeviceId, deviceCode: metadata.deviceName, valveStatus: body.valveStatus || 'UNKNOWN', valveOpeningPercent: body.valveOpeningPercent, success: body.lastCommandStatus !== 'FAILED', errorCode: body.valveErrorCode || null, errorMessage: body.errorMessage || null, timestamp: metadata.ts || new Date().toISOString()}, metadata: metadata, msgType: msgType};

safety.note: This skeleton forwards ACK/telemetry only. It does not authorize valve opening and does not bypass AgriOS Safety / Approval / ActionQueue / DeviceControl.
